72: And if because of the Sabbath - And if you are going to suggest that the gentile will rely [on the fact] that the Jew will not come [return] on the Sabbath, I was told by Issur the Convert etc.
Less less than 4 cubits - And one stops to rest [within 4 cubits], so that there is no uplift from the start of the 4 cubits to the end of [full] 4 cubits. {and thus  avoids transgressing}.
